name: nulo-v6-reference-vectors
description: Self-contained NULO-ACCOUNT-KDF v2 reference project for the nulo-v6 account regime. Run: bun install && bun derive-vectors.ts > vectors.json — from THIS directory. Imports ONLY the published 6.0.0-rc.1 packages plus node:crypto (a deliberately DIFFERENT PBKDF2 implementation than the wallet's WebCrypto, for cross-implementation verification); never the repo's own helpers.
